headline: Rupiah Strengthens to 17,840 per US Dollar After BI Rate Holds at 5.75%
summary: The rupiah rose 22 points to 17,840 per US dollar at the close after Bank Indonesia held its BI Rate at 5.75%.
why: Bank Indonesia sets the benchmark policy rate, and its decisions influence the rupiah, Indonesian bond yields and capital flows into the country.
why_moved: Bank Indonesia's decision to hold the BI Rate at 5.75% was cited as the trigger for the rupiah's gain against the US dollar.
